summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.1 to extract core crypto functionality into shared SDK packages (@cipherbox/core, @cipherbox/api-client, @cipherbox/sdk-core, @cipherbox/sdk) and rewire the web app to consume them.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans completed across 5 waves. PR #296 created. Significant debugging occurred during Plan 05 checkpoint, resolving 7 integration bugs before all file operations were verified via Playwright MCP.

repo: IPNS sequence numbers are authoritative in the SDK after first registration — overwriting with Zustand store data causes 409 conflicts. ensureFolderRegistered must skip if SDK already knows the folder.
@cipherbox/api-client requires setApiClientConfig() to be called before any generated functions work — SDK init in useAuth.ts is the right place.
Folder navigation uses UUID (FolderEntry.id), not ipnsName. createFolder() must return the UUID for correct store registration.
Dual-path IPNS writes (SDK + old service writing to same IPNS records) cause irreconcilable sequence number conflicts. Single writer pattern is required.
SDK bin requires loadBin() after old initializeBin() completes so binState is populated. Fresh accounts have no IPNS record — loadBin should return empty BinState not null.
The .buffer accessor on a Uint8Array slice is unsafe per CLAUDE.md — must use .slice().buffer to get a copy-backed ArrayBuffer.
TEE key wrapping pattern (hexToBytes → wrapKey → bytesToHex) is duplicated 5+ times across packages — flagged for consolidation in future phase.
Integration tests require TEST_LOGIN_SECRET env var and a running API. Never skip them — run pnpm dev first.
Codecov baseline thresholds: core ~76%, sdk ~69%, sdk-core 100%, crypto ~85%, api ~98%.
The root typecheck script must build all 5 packages (crypto, core, api-client, sdk-core, sdk) before running tsc -b on the web app, or CI type declarations are missing.
orval regeneration must be re-run after import changes touch the web app's API client — otherwise CI API spec check fails.

code.finding: destroy() zeros vault privateKey, publicKey, and rootFolderKey. Security review M-2 fix.
axios instance is now cached after setApiClientConfig() and reused across all API calls — was creating a new instance per request previously.
loadBin() returns empty BinState (entries:[], sequenceNumber:0) when no IPNS record exists. Enables deleteToBin() on fresh accounts without 'Bin not loaded' error.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish retries once on 409 by re-resolving current IPNS sequence number. Handles stale seq from background polling or previous sessions.
btoa(String.fromCharCode(...spread)) replaced with loop-based base64 — the spread approach can stack-overflow for large records (>65k bytes).
ensureFolderRegistered() early-returns if client.hasFolder(ipnsName) — prevents corrupting SDK's internal sequence number and IPNS private key with stale Zustand store data.
_sdkUnsubscribe moved to module-level variable instead of Zustand state — was triggering spurious re-renders on every subscribe/unsubscribe call.
handleCreate uses result.id (UUID from FolderEntry) not result.ipnsName for store key. Navigation lookup by child ID uses UUID, not ipnsName.
saveBinMetadata now accepts BinOperationContext directly instead of destructuring 4 fields at every call site — was 4x4 lines of mechanical field forwarding.
BinNotLoadedError typed error class exported from @cipherbox/sdk — replaces string matching (.message.includes('Bin not loaded')) in useFolderMutations.

workflow: Playwright MCP login flow: trigger OTP via UI, then grep the backgrounded pnpm dev task output file for 'DEV OTP' — the local API generates random OTPs, not the static Web3Auth test OTP from .env.
Playwright MCP file upload: use browser_evaluate to call .click() on the hidden <input type='file'> element, then use browser_file_upload. The upload zone overlay intercepts pointer events.
Use fresh random emails (e.g. test-${Date.now()}@example.com) for each Playwright test run to avoid auth_methods constraint violations and slow vault sync from accumulated IPNS records.
Parallel code review via 3 simultaneous agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) is effective — all 3 found the same critical issues (N+1 IPNS publishes, orphan cleanup, btoa spread) independently.
Atomic commits per fix (not per file) makes git history readable and PR review tractable — especially important when fixing 7+ distinct bugs in one checkpoint.
For SDK integration: always validate at SDK level first (unit/integration tests), then validate UI behavior via Playwright — avoids wasting Playwright time on bugs detectable in pure TS.
When branch reset is needed after unhappy implementation, prefer reset to main and re-execute rather than incremental revert — cleaner history.
Code review agents should be given the full diff — they found 9 actionable issues that weren't caught in initial implementation.

friction: 1Password SSH agent is not accessible from Claude subprocess — git commit signing failed repeatedly, requiring user to be at keyboard. Blocked phase completion commits multiple times.
OTP retrieval was unnecessarily complex: initial attempts used Web3Auth static test OTP instead of reading from local API task output. Then hit rate limits requiring Redis cache clearing.
First execute-phase invocation had a typo (Phase 9.1 instead of 19.1) — caused an interrupt and restart.
Plan 02 implementation was rejected by user and required full branch reset to main, re-running waves 1-2 from scratch.
Playwright MCP file upload required multiple failed attempts (file chooser modal, overlay intercept) before finding the browser_evaluate workaround.
CI had 3 separate failures after push (typecheck missing package builds, API spec drift from regeneration, coverage thresholds too high) requiring an additional fix commit.
The bin empty-state fix required multiple iteration cycles: loadBin timing issue → ordering fix → still empty → discovered different resolution paths between old service and SDK.
open_items: Batch SDK operations: useBin.restoreMultiple/permanentDeleteMultiple and useFolderMutations batch move/delete do N sequential IPNS publishes instead of batch. Needs SDK batch API (moveItems, deleteItems, etc.).
@internal methods (getConfig, getContext, getFolderTree, emitEvent) are public on CipherBoxClient — getConfig() exposes vault private key to any consumer with a client reference.
Duplicate bin loading on login: initializeBin (old service) + getSdkClient().loadBin() both resolve same IPNS record. Deferred until old service is removed.
uint8ToBase64 has 3 copies across packages (sdk-core/file, web/folder.service, web/file-metadata.service) — should be in @cipherbox/crypto or @cipherbox/core.
TEE key wrapping pattern duplicated 5+ times — extract to shared helper in sdk-core.
Duplicate file upload path (replace dialog flow) still uses old encryptFile + addToIpfs services, not SDK.
O(N) linear scan for folder lookup on every SDK folder:loaded/folder:updated event — needs reverse lookup map (ipnsName → folderId).
revokeShare and reWrapForRecipients take injected callback functions instead of calling @cipherbox/api-client directly — pushes API wiring responsibility to consumers.
publicKey: new Uint8Array(0) placeholder in FolderState — field is never read but the type requires it. Should be removed from FolderState type or made optional.
